concept: A short message about something that just happened, in a level-4 pane at the top end, announced politely and leaving by itself.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a coloured banner toast with a filled background per status (green success, red error)
default_to_avoid.why_not: a full green or red fill gives the system hues it does not own and shouts

derivation.consequence: one solid fill exists, the loud solid (white in dark, ink in light); a promoted action is the same solid glowing with its own light, and a pane uses one of them
derivation.form: the status is a small mark beside the title; the pane itself stays glass

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: a level-4 pane, the top of the stack, with the longest shadow

derivation.consequence: long ease-out curves (420 to 640ms) for arriving and hovering, a shorter one (200ms) for pressing because a press is a reply; under reduced motion every duration is zero at the token level
derivation.form: it rises a short way, settles, pauses under the pointer and fades out

options: A level-4 pane with a status mark
variants.picked: A level-4 pane with a status mark
variants.reason: A keeps colour to the mark (P5). B fills the pane with a hue. C covers the navigation.

viewport.why: the column at the top end where toasts stack, one gap apart

toast.why: a level-4 pane, blurred, with the longest shadow

mark.why: the tone is a glyph shape in the tone colour, the same shapes as Banner and Badge, so it reads without colour

info.why: neutral information takes the secondary text colour, the same in every theme and on every scene

positive.why: a success takes the positive mark colour, the same in every theme and on every scene

critical.why: a failure takes the critical mark colour, the same in every theme and on every scene

text.why: the title and description stacked, taking the free width

title.why: what happened, in the body size, semibold, the same in every theme and on every scene

description.why: one more sentence in secondary text, the same in every theme and on every scene

action.why: one action with a 44px target, the same in every theme and on every scene

close.why: a dismiss button with a 44px target, the same in every theme and on every scene

previewViewport.why: in a preview the toast sits in place in its parent instead of the top end of the screen

sr.why: the tone is said as a word before the title, so a screen reader hears Error before the message and colour is never the only cue

data-state=open.why: an open toast rises and settles, the same in every theme and on every scene

data-state=closed.why: a closing toast fades out, the same in every theme and on every scene

data-swipe=move.why: it follows the finger while swiped, the same in every theme and on every scene

data-swipe=end.why: a swiped toast fades out, the same in every theme and on every scene

hover.why: a button tints under the pointer, the same in every theme and on every scene

focus-visible.why: the focus ring on the action and the close

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours outline the pane, the same in every theme and on every scene

empty.why: an empty region takes no room and catches no presses, so it never blocks the page under it

@rise.why: rises a short way from the top and settles

@fade.why: fades out when it leaves, the same in every theme and on every scene
